items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Sidney invited me to a rehearsal at that time he was getting his band ready to go on the Steamer Capital and I went to a rehearsal once and he said well you're in.

ctx.x: And after Sidney heard me play why Sidney invited me to a rehearsal at that time he was getting his band ready to go on the Steamer Capital and I went to a rehearsal once and he said well you're in.
